tools.world_editor.parameters.section: objects/details.oni: status, properties, personality, work, or freshness. Requires instance id or query; default status. Freshness reads one selected live food item at a time by default.
tools.world_editor.parameters.includeFre: For section=freshness only: include existing raw rot modifiers, preserving order and UIOnly flags. Defaults to false; returns at most 16 rows with the native total count. Does not refresh state or evaluate UI tooltips.
food_freshness.error.section: section must be status, properties, personality, work, or freshness.
food_freshness.error.modifiers_boolean: includeFreshnessModifiers must be a JSON boolean for section=freshness.
food_freshness.listing.objects: Independent live status, properties, personality, work and food freshness reads.
food_freshness.listing.details: Live sections: id/query and section=status/properties/personality/work/freshness. Raw freshness modifiers require includeFreshnessModifiers=true.
food_freshness.active_index.details: - `/active/objects/details.oni`: live object sections, id/query, section=status/properties/personality/work/freshness; freshness modifiers are explicit only.
food_freshness.resource.food_description: Food inventory and access totals. Read an actual item at /active/objects/details.oni with section=freshness for freshness and the current rot rate.
